reason: I like the label, real mate, no sweeteners, 4 g of sugar, but I already get my caffeine from coffee and matcha I make myself for a fraction of 54 CZK. Committing 688 CZK with shipping to a 12-pack of something I've never tasted doesn't make sense, numbered cans or not.
objection: It's pricier than a Red Bull and much pricier than my own coffee, and I don't know if sparkling mate with grapefruit even tastes good. Twelve cans is a lot to gamble on.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a free tasting can at an event or after a race and actually liking it; then I might buy a single at a cafe or a smaller pack for long rides.
